declarations.summary: ATOMIC_ACTION וכן תעשה עד אשר P performs the action once, then checks P after each occurrence and repeats the same atomic act until P holds.
Reusable described computation is named as מעשה; introduction uses יהי מעשה ושמו NAME and reference uses המעשה אשר שמו NAME.
Explicit performance is עשה את המעשה אשר שמו NAME; a bare name is never invocation.
מקום is a source-semantic changeable-state holder, distinct from its current numeric occupant and from implementation memory.
ACTION עד אשר P and ACTION וכן עשה עד אשר P are not the canonical Core recurrence; the admitted form contains וכן תעשה.
מצוה is superseded as the primary Core reusable-computation abstraction; C must not preserve A8 syntax for compatibility.
Initialized place introduction explicitly names the place and states its sole current numeric occupant.
Replacement explicitly names destination, new occupant, and displaced current numeric occupant.
המעשה הזה is the current performance occurrence only inside an act body; it is a source deictic, not a stack-frame lookup rule.
A numeric input role is a named דבר owned by a named מעשה; role identity is explicit and never positional.
A result reference is immediate and uniquely determined; there is no hidden global last-result register or historical nearest-result lookup.
A final value is not an implicit result and result production is not abrupt Return/tuple-return semantics.
Actual inputs are not matched to roles by order; every required named role must be associated exactly once.
Performance associates a pure numeric Value with an explicitly named role via בהיות VALUE תחת ROLE; source order does not establish matching.
A named act body is delimited by singular זה דבר המעשה אשר שמו NAME ... עד הנה דבר המעשה אשר שמו NAME; the explicit names must co-refer and layout has no boundary force.
Core v0.1 admits exactly the frozen canonical direct numeral spellings 1..9999 inside המספר אשר הוא NUMERAL; this is a direct-literal admission frontier, not a semantic numeric bound.
The single Core result may be referred to only by the explicit immediate form המספר אשר יצא עתה מן המעשה אשר שמו ACT; no ordinal or hidden last-result convention is admitted.
A11 אלה דברי המעשה / עד הנה דברי המעשה is superseded and is not a compatibility alias in A12.
A12 Core permits zero or one numeric output and rejects A11 ordinal/positional multi-result access.
A11 performance-owned mutable local places are not part of frozen A-Core v0.1; future local-state design remains open.
המעשה הזה is a source deictic for the current performance occurrence, not a stack-frame or caller-chain lookup convention.
הוצא מן המעשה הזה את VALUE produces the at-most-one Core numeric output of the current performance and does not itself terminate the act.
A Core program is preparatory discourse followed by exactly one top-level ועתה transition and one explicit executable sequence.
Core subtraction B-A is defined only for A<=B; B12 maps failure to ARITHMETIC_DOMAIN_ERROR rather than a signed value.
Normal exhaustion is completion; no Core HALT/exit/main-return construction exists.
Initialized place introduction, act introduction, role declaration and act body definition are preparatory units, not top-level executable actions.
ועתה explicitly transitions from preparation to the principal execution; it is not a magic main act.
Core uses source discourse introduction-before-use with typed identities, no hoisting, and occurrence-local role values.
Exact N פעמים recurrence is admitted only for counts whose morphology and repeated material are structurally closed.
Where order matters, the retained overt temporal relation is ואחרי כן; source order and bare waw do not create sequence.
A referent is not silently replaced by its current content merely because an implementation stores content in a cell.
Positional argument matching is unavailable unless linguistic role marking later licenses it.
VALUE_A הוא VALUE_B is the retained exact numeric identity proposition in the controlled numeric frame.
Conditional consequence uses the paired Hebrew shell אם P A ואם לא B; no dangling-else convention is available.
Pure addition uses the explicit Biblical-Hebrew valency frame המספר הנחשב בהוסיף את A על B.
Pure subtraction uses the explicit Biblical-Hebrew valency frame המספר הנחשב בגרע את A מן B.
Bare עד אשר does not select a conventional pre-test or post-test recurrence model.
Year-profile BidirectionalIndex literals and total successor/predecessor.
Strict Natural greater-than proposition.
A15 direct Naturals 1..99,999,999 with exact canonical magnitude grammar.
Finite Symbol domain/member declarations with counted canonical visible-label metadata.
Same-domain Symbol identity proposition.
Explicit adjacent Symbol-order metadata.
Exact domain-qualified Symbol values and typed carrier references.
Named performance associations over independently typed values.
Symbol/Index output production and typed immediate-result references.
Symbol/Index place initialization, current content and replacement.
Symbol/Index named-role declarations and current occurrence values.
Collection places, named roles, output and immediate result.
The six admitted finite ordered book kinds only.
Collection membership proposition with domain semantic equality.
Typed empty books, pure append, selection and deterministic ordering.
Dynamic counts are existing Natural Value descriptions with only their initial numeric head inflected to כמספר.
RepeatExactly determines one Natural count once at entry and repeats exactly one atomic action; no iterator or implicit result collection exists.

semantic_gates.reason: B11 maps A12 described-act performance exactly to semantic performance occurrences without requiring call frames.
B11 maps המעשה הזה to the current semantic performance occurrence, not to an observable stack frame or caller chain.
B11 maps A12 named numeric roles to non-positional semantic role identities and explicit associations.
B11 freezes explicit non-positional Value-to-role association for each performance occurrence.
B11 maps the frozen A12 body delimiters to described-act body execution with ordinary completion at exhaustion.
B11 maps the A12 immediate single-result description to the explicitly resolved just-completed performance; no hidden last-result register exists.
B11 freezes zero-or-one numeric output production as part of the current performance and explicitly separates output from completion.
